field_principles.action_efficiency_ratio: baseline_actions / verifier_actions; the EFFICIENCY axis of the north star (the action-pruner's load-bearing value).
field_principles.baseline_actions: Actions-to-solve under random/greedy; the reference the offline-beats-baseline gate compares against.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. An honest 'verifier pruner is N x more action-efficient, no new level solved offline' is a COMPLETE and north-star-advancing verdict.
field_principles.real_env_confirmed: Bare bool: false here (offline/air-gapped); only real-env solves raise the official headline count.
field_principles.total_games_solved: Monotonic progress metric; must be >= the prior milestone's 13 (offline).
field_principles.verifier_actions: Actions-to-solve under verifier-grounded pruning; the measured efficiency numerator's counterpart.
